campaigns.notes: the books tallest edge overlaps the top edge of the buttons, the click continue button is an acceptable replacement for the original interaction. replace the health display with a more truthful/useful info source

home.notes:
the row of buttons at the top that say "home/make/etc" are in a weird sub pane with green on green buttons. it feels messy to have it in a floating pane. just have it be the buttons. 

Bind and depart should say where it takes you, because bind and depart should actually mean you bind it and go to the world, not just 'go to the writing desk'

writing-desk.notes: the side by side view is nonviable for scrolling through the wide variety of runes we have

library.notes: I don't see how this makes sense for the way the game works but the aesthetic is good. just needs to be way more functional for the actual game.

bestiary.notes: images should be smaller, item sized until you view them in detail
